audience.programmeDescription: Bèta-gamma combines natural and social sciences at the University of Amsterdam. Students study a common first year, then specialise in a major while continuing interdisciplinary project work.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The table shows confirmed parts of the curriculum with the Earth Sciences major. The UCR comparison depends on verifying the entry requirements for the two final-year projects.
